Question ID: MAR_U02_L01_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.MAR.PHY.01

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Ocean Basins and Seafloor Features
Stimulus: Bathymetry/seafloor map

A student reviews the assigned marine evidence and must explain the first clear pattern. Which answer uses the marine evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, Read the map title, scale, and legend. Then use the required stimulus (Bathymetry/seafloor map) to connect the visible evidence to ocean maps, bathymetry, sonar evidence, scale, and seafloor features. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.MAR.PHY.01 and avoids this common mistake: reading a marine map as a picture instead of using scale, labels, depth, and evidence.
